model.name: Identity & Access Posture Maturity
model.description: cmdash-authored maturity model for O.5 (Identity Posture) — docs/design/telemetry-scoring.md's IDENTITY_POSTURE observation class. Three dimensions (MFA enforcement, account lifecycle hygiene, privileged access governance) each map to CIS Controls v8 Account/Access Management safeguards and NIST CSF 2.0 PR.AA subcategories, and are additionally fed by continuous OBSERVED-tier telemetry from identity-provider adapters (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) via MaturityObservation, normalized through the shared normalizeObservation IDENTITY_POSTURE curve.

provenance.license: cmdash proprietary — internal maturity content pack, no external license

levels.name: Initial: Ad Hoc Identity Practices
levels.description: MFA enrollment, account lifecycle, and privileged-access reviews are inconsistent and largely manual. Dormant and orphaned accounts persist unnoticed. Administrative privilege is granted broadly and rarely revisited.

levels.name: Developing: Baseline Identity Controls
levels.description: MFA is required for at least the most sensitive access paths (admin, remote, externally-exposed apps). Dormant-account detection exists but runs ad hoc. Privileged accounts are inventoried, though restriction is inconsistent.

levels.name: Managed: Enforced & Monitored Identity Controls
levels.description: MFA is enforced broadly across the workforce, not just privileged users. Dormant/stale accounts are disabled on a defined cadence. Privileged access follows least-privilege, is centrally managed, and is periodically reviewed.

levels.name: Optimized: Continuously Validated Identity Assurance
levels.description: MFA coverage, dormant-account ratio, and privileged-account ratio are continuously telemetered and trending favorably, not just point-in-time attested. Identity posture regressions are caught and remediated automatically or near-automatically.

dimensions.name: Multi-Factor Authentication Enforcement
dimensions.description: The breadth and consistency of MFA enforcement across the workforce — not just for administrators, but for every account capable of accessing sensitive systems. Continuously fed by the tenant's identity-provider MFA-coverage percentage (Okta/Entra ID), projected from the same fact PostureEngine's MFA_COVERAGE signal already ingests (docs/design/telemetry-scoring.md §6) rather than re-ingested as a second copy.

dimensions.name: Account Lifecycle Hygiene
dimensions.description: How consistently dormant, stale, and orphaned accounts are detected and disabled. Continuously fed by identity-provider dormant/stale-account-ratio observations (IDENTITY_POSTURE, `dormantAccountRatio` metric) — a lower ratio scores higher.

dimensions.name: Privileged Access Governance
dimensions.description: The concentration and governance of standing administrative privilege — fewer, better-managed privileged accounts reduce the blast radius of any single compromised credential. Continuously fed by identity-provider privileged-account-ratio observations (IDENTITY_POSTURE, `privilegedAccountRatio` metric) — a lower ratio scores higher.
